title: White is not pure white
text:
White is not pure white. The white versions of these napkins are not pure white. They are slightly off-white. More like an antique white.
They are not truly 20x20. Each napkin varies a little in size.

product_metadata.title: Ramanta Home 12-Pack 100% Cotton Dinner Napkins 18 by 18-Inch Soft Absorbent Comfortable - Ideal for Events and Regular Use - Black
